thread:
sana.k: Hi team — small Q. I got married and my partner and I are finalizing paperwork. Can I add them midyear? What deadline and docs do you need?

maria.peopleops: Congrats! Marriage is a Qualifying Life Event. You have 30 days from the marriage date to submit a QLE request and docs.

sana.k: Cool. What documents are acceptable? We married abroad and have a foreign certificate.

maria.peopleops: Acceptable:
- Government-issued marriage certificate (foreign ok) + English translation if not in English
- Apostille if available (helps speed carrier acceptance)
- Passport or ID showing names if certificate lists different ordering
We recommend PDFs. If translation is needed, a certified translation or notarized translation helps.

sana.k: Is there a payroll proration or will deductions start next month?

maria.peopleops: Depends on carrier cutoff. If processed quickly we can request the effective date = marriage date and prorate. Otherwise it might be 1st of next month. We'll estimate deductions before payroll posts.

sana.k: How do I submit?

maria.peopleops: Email benefits@redwood.com with subject: "QLE: Add spouse <sana.k>" or upload via People Ops portal > Benefits > QLE uploads. benefits-bot will reply with a case number.

benefits-bot: Acknowledged. If you upload now, case #RB-2189 created. Carrier verification may take 3-7 business days.

sana.k: Thanks — uploading now. Will ping when done.

maria.peopleops: Happy to help, ping us after upload if you want a quick check.
